description: We’re a Delhi-based team joining NASA Space Apps 2026 to explore Earth system trends through technology, data, and creativity. Our interests include AI/ML, Earth science, data analysis, visualization, web development, design, and storytelling. We’re looking for passionate teammates skilled in coding, research, AI/ML, UI/UX, data, or communication who want to collaborate and build an innovative solution.

details:
What the Project Does

EarthTrend Detective is a data-driven environmental research and visualization project that explores soil-moisture variability across Jharkhand, India. It uses NASA's Soil Moisture Active Passive (SMAP) satellite observations and Global Precipitation Measurement (GPM) rainfall data to investigate how soil moisture changes over time and across geographical locations.

How It Works

The project processes monthly satellite observations and rainfall records to examine:

  • Long-term soil-moisture trends.
  • Seasonal variations in soil moisture.
  • Relationships between rainfall and soil-moisture anomalies.
  • Potential dry and wet extreme conditions.
  • Spatial differences across mapped locations in Jharkhand.

Statistical methods and geospatial visualizations help users explore the observations through an interactive dashboard.

Benefits and Intended Impact

The project demonstrates how Earth observation data can be transformed into understandable environmental information. It can support researchers, students, environmental analysts and agricultural stakeholders in exploring regional soil-moisture patterns and rainfall variability.

Its longer-term potential is to contribute to climate-resilience research and the development of better regional environmental monitoring tools.

Technology and Tools

The project uses Python for data processing and statistical analysis, NASA SMAP and GPM datasets for satellite observations, geospatial processing and visualization tools, and a web-based dashboard for presenting results.

The project is publicly available through its GitHub repository and deployed web dashboard.

Creativity and Scientific Considerations

The project's creative approach combines satellite soil-moisture observations, rainfall information, statistical analysis and geographical visualization in one research platform.

It considers data coverage, missing observations, spatial resolution, seasonal variability, statistical significance and the limitations of satellite-derived measurements.

The analysis identified a strong relationship between rainfall and soil-moisture anomalies. However, the state-wide long-term trend analysis did not show statistically significant drying. Correlation is not proof of causation, and potential extreme conditions are not automatically confirmed drought or flood events.

EarthTrend Detective is intended as an exploratory research and monitoring tool, not an official agricultural warning or forecasting system.
